integrity: Proof supplies a necessary-and-sufficient compatibility identity, exact rank-one inverse and affine-fiber dimension; standalone numeric checks corroborate a rational example without substituting for analytical proof.
scientific_limitations: Large-population deterministic final-size and early exponential-recovery branching regime. Non-rank-one aliases are effective positive kernels not required to obey balanced factorized-contact constraints. No noise robustness, finite-sample statistical inference, or independent historical-priority validation.
title: Joint epidemic attack and seeding profiles: a unique rank-one kernel inside an affine observational family
